reason: Research was thin, so this HOLD rests mostly on the packet. A WebSearch on semiconductor news for the week of 2026-10-09 found nothing current: results were late-2025 and early-2026 outlook pieces, plus an undated TSMC earnings item that may be from January 2026. I did not find current Nvidia, TSMC or ASML price action, so I have no evidenced basis to rotate the book. The book is down about 3% in the 2026-10-09 marks with a 21% cash cushion and no legs at stop levels. Trading now would add churn costs on a stale view. The Round 3 novelty rule is respected because this book is an unchanged HOLD and carries no new overlap with Round 2 (the R2 book holds MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, META, AAPL, BRK.B, UNH, COST and JPM; the R3 book holds AVGO, TSM, QCOM, AMAT, CRWD, ADBE, ASML and SMH). This HOLD is an admitted limitation of the research, not a considered view on each leg.
